set.body: Public-API audit reproduces silent voxel mixing: subject maps (1,10) at indices (0,1), (20,2) at (1,0), and (3,30) at (0,1) are accepted against VoxelAxis(0,1), producing group means (8,14) instead of (2,20). The bridge also accepts a TContrastResult whose name differs from its requested contrast key, and squares negative SEs into positive variances. Owner: ScalaFIM group FirstLevel bridge; coordinate richer source provenance with fit/workflow providers. Acceptance: align by authoritative voxel identity or fail with a typed reason; reject duplicates/substitutions and invalid uncertainty; preserve explicit rename semantics if supported; JVM+JS regressions through the public API. Evidence: group audit bd-01M20MJY5QG8F7X2ZQENTTWPD7 and tools/group-audit/shared/GroupAuditSuite.scala. Fix before PLS Neuro group-GLM admission.
set.title: Group bridge: enforce first-level spatial identity and uncertainty validity
